name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A date field with a floating label and glowing focus halo that opens the Calendar in a spring sheet (drag the grabber to dismiss, a dialog on wide screens) or an anchored popover. Single or range mode, one-tap presets like Next 7 days and Next weekend, optional Clear / Done staging with a live summary, Intl formatting, error shake with an icon message and a success check.
summary: A floating-label date field that opens the calendar in a draggable spring sheet.
behavior: Tap the field to open the picker. In a sheet, drag the grabber header down (or flick it) to dismiss.
The label floats onto the border and a focus halo springs in while open. An error shakes the field once and its message springs in below.
The field is a button labelled with your label, with the date (or "Not set") as its value and an expanded state. Helper, error and success messages are polite live regions.
With presentation 'auto' it opens a bottom sheet on phones and a centred dialog from 640pt wide.
props: Rests in the field, floats onto the border when open or filled.
Set to false to put the label above the field as static text (no notch) and show placeholder inside.
One date or a start / end range.
Called with the committed date / range, or null when cleared.
auto: bottom sheet on phones, centred dialog from 640pt wide · sheet: always a bottom sheet with drag-to-dismiss · dialog: always a centred modal · popover: drops under the field.
true adds built-in shortcuts (Today, Next 7 days, Next weekend, This month…); or pass your own.
Stage picks behind Clear / Done; otherwise picking (or finishing a range) closes the picker.
Show an × in the field that clears the value.
Custom formatter for each date shown in the field.
Intl options for the field text.
Locale for the field and the calendar.
Shown in the field while open with nothing picked, and in the sheet header.
Selectable bounds; presets outside them are disabled.
Show neighbouring-month days in the grid.
Red border, icon message and one shake.
Success border and check; a string is shown under the field.
Dims the field and blocks opening.
Background behind the field (the label notch uses it).
Called when the picker opens or closes.

The bordered box: background, border width / colour, radius, height, padding. Wins over the computed style; a borderColor replaces the resting border only (focus, error and success colours still show). A numeric height / borderRadius re-centres the label and resizes the halo.
The formatted date text in the trigger.

Label in both modes (floating and above). color is the resting colour — focus (accent), error and success still take over; fontSize sets the resting size, it floats at the same ratio and the notch follows its width.
Helper / error / success text. color applies to the helper; error and success keep their tone colour.
Calendar icon and clear × colour at rest (calendar turns accent while open).
Sheet / dialog / popover panel — background, border, radius, padding, shadow (transform and opacity are animated).
